newsitem.title: USA: N.H. 1,164 MW Seabrook nuke seen back this weekend.
newsitem.headline: N.H. 1,164 MW Seabrook nuke seen back this weekend.

text.p: The 1,164 megawatt (MW) nuclear power plant in Seabrook, New Hampshire, is expected to return to service this weekend following a refueling outage that began in early May, the operator said Wednesday.
"We're fully heated...at full temperature and pressure," said a spokesman for North Atlantic Energy Service Corp.
The plant reached "hot standby" mode early Wednesday, which means its reactor is ready for restart but not yet active, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission reported in its daily plant status report.
According to the latest schedule, the reactor is set to put power on the grid by Saturday, the spokesman said.
Northeast Utilities is the majority owner of Seabrook with a 39.6 percent stake. Other Seabrook owners include New England Electric System, United Illuminating Co and Eastern Utilities Associates.
